# Linen par handbook, Riverside Hotel

## Contents
1 Bath towels  2 Flat sheets  3 Duvet covers  4 Bath mats

## 1 Bath towels
Par is 4 per occupied room: one on the rail, one in use, two in the drop.

## 2 Flat sheets
Par is 5 per occupied room.

(Pending: section 3 Duvet covers awaits the floor supervisors' counts; this edition carries no duvet numbers.)
